mission.description: Canonical Imazu problem 9, reproduced from Sawada et al. (2021) Table 4 (J. Mar. Sci. Technol. 26(2), 509-524) -- exact published own-ship/target start positions (NM), headings (deg), and speeds (kn), so results are directly comparable against other papers using the same published Imazu problem set. ts1 crosses from starboard (broad); ts2 crosses from starboard (broad).
pass_criteria: Own-ship gives way early and substantially (normally to starboard) for the target(s) crossing from starboard, and avoids crossing ahead if circumstances allow.
Own-ship's manoeuvre for one target does not create a new close-quarters situation with another (Rule 8(d)).
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.

You are the navigator on a large commercial vessel. Decide the next helm order.

MISSION REQUIREMENTS -- this mission is only completed successfully if ALL of these hold, not just
the first one you happen to satisfy:
1. Every contact's CPA stays at or above this mission's safe passing distance (given further below)
   at all times -- exactly as mandatory as actually reaching the goal. There is no automatic safety
   net correcting your choice if you get this wrong: your own action each step is what the ship
